meta.title: Fossil fuel production
meta.source: Energy Institute, Statistical Review of World Energy (2025), via Our World in Data energy dataset (legacy release)
meta.license: CC BY 4.0 (Our World in Data); Energy Institute data used with attribution
meta.notes: Oil, gas and coal production in terawatt-hours of primary energy.

meta.title: Crop production
meta.source: FAO, FAOSTAT Crops and livestock products (QCL), bulk download
meta.notes: Production quantity in tonnes. China is FAOSTAT “China, mainland” (M49 156); Taiwan is reported separately.

meta.title: Strategic commodity trade
meta.source: United Nations, UN Comtrade database (API v1), annual HS data as reported
meta.license: UN Comtrade terms of use: free for non-commercial use with attribution
meta.notes: Exports and imports of each strategic commodity with the world, summing its HS codes (see shared/commodities.ts). Reporter-declared values in US dollars; latest year within 3 years per reporter and commodity. No world total: not every country reports.

meta.title: Mineral production and reserves
meta.source: U.S. Geological Survey, Mineral Commodity Summaries data release
meta.notes: Mine and refinery production and reserves as published, in each commodity's USGS unit. Withheld (W) and unavailable values are missing.

meta.title: Trade profiles per country
meta.source: United Nations, UN Comtrade database (API v1), annual HS data as reported

meta.notes: Goods only (no services). Reporter-declared values: exports FOB, imports CIF. Latest year within 3 years per reporter; countries that did not report are missing.
